With Ctrl, the two pan directions are at right angles, so two components of 1/√2 still add up to the same total distance.

One thing I'm not sure of: the note doesn't say whether the split still applies when one of the keys is zooming (Alt+Up) or both are panning (Ctrl), and I couldn't run the library to check. I also assumed Alt+Right on its own turns `alpha` as usual, since the notes only mention Alt changing the Up key.
